lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Ottawa’s mayor and officials with police, paramedics and public health are urging drivers to slow down and all road users to eliminate distractions and pay attention after a deadly month on the roads, The Canadian Press reports.
Canada’s much-anticipated summit with the European Union begins today after months of speculation around how a new alliance between the two bodies will take shape, The Canadian Press reports.

The Trump administration said Wednesday that it is blocking shipments by the Chinese biotech company BGI Group and its affiliates, alleging ties to forced labour in China’s far-west ethnic region of Xinjiang, The Associated Press reports.
Patrick Stewart starred on stage and screen across his decadeslong acting career, The Associated Press reports.
The Justice Department has begun issuing a new wave of subpoenas stemming from an ongoing criminal investigation into Alaska’s U.S, CBS News reports.
The father of Tumbler Ridge attack victim Maya Gebala says she is being released from BC Children’s Hospital, more than eight months after being shot three times, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
